parts.title: Part 1 — Picture description
parts.instructions: You will hear ten short recordings. For each one, choose the picture that answers the question. You may play each recording twice.

items.prompt: What time does the next train to Da Nang leave?

script.text: Excuse me, what time does the next train to Da Nang leave?
The seven fifteen was cancelled, I'm afraid. The next one goes at seven forty-five.
Seven forty-five. Thank you.

items.explain: Chuyến 7:15 bị huỷ (cancelled). Chuyến kế tiếp là 7:45.

items.prompt: What will the weather be like tomorrow?

script.text: Should I take an umbrella tomorrow?
No need. The rain stops tonight, and tomorrow is going to be bright and sunny all day.

items.explain: Mưa tạnh tối nay; ngày mai "bright and sunny" — trời nắng.

items.prompt: Where is the woman going now?

script.text: I can't come for coffee yet. I have to return these books before five o'clock or I'll pay a fine.
Alright, I'll wait for you here.

items.explain: "Return these books" và "pay a fine" — trả sách ở thư viện.

items.prompt: What did the man buy?

script.text: I went to town to look at cameras, but they were all far too expensive. So I bought a pair of running shoes instead.

items.explain: Anh ấy chỉ đi xem máy ảnh, nhưng thứ đã mua (bought) là giày chạy bộ.

items.prompt: How does the girl travel to school now?

script.text: I used to take the bus every morning, but since we moved closer to school I cycle instead. It only takes ten minutes.

items.explain: "I used to take the bus" là quá khứ. Hiện tại: "I cycle" — đi xe đạp.

items.prompt: Which sport does the man do now?

script.text: I had to give up football after I hurt my knee. These days I swim three times a week — it's much easier on the joints.

items.explain: Anh ấy đã bỏ bóng đá (give up football). Hiện tại bơi ba lần một tuần.

items.prompt: What time does the meeting start?

script.text: Don't forget the meeting is at nine thirty.
Actually, they moved it back. It starts at ten o'clock now.

items.explain: Cuộc họp đã bị dời (moved it back) sang 10 giờ.

items.prompt: What is in the man's bag?

script.text: Please be careful with that bag when you put it down. My laptop is inside and the screen cracks easily.

items.explain: "My laptop is inside" — trong túi là máy tính xách tay.

items.prompt: Which room does the woman want?

script.text: We'd like a room for two people, please. My sister and I would prefer separate beds rather than one big one.

items.explain: Hai người nhưng muốn giường riêng (separate beds) — phòng twin.

items.prompt: What are they going to eat tonight?

script.text: Shall we order pizza again?
We had pizza twice this week. Let's get noodles instead — there's a good place on Tran Phu street.
Good idea.

items.explain: Cô ấy từ chối pizza và đề nghị "let's get noodles instead".

parts.title: Part 2 — Conversation: Right or Wrong
parts.vi: Nghe hội thoại và chọn Đúng / Sai
parts.instructions: Listen to Mai and Tuan talking about a weekend trip. Decide whether each statement is RIGHT or WRONG.

script.text: Tuan, are you still coming to Da Lat with us on Saturday?
I want to, but I'm not sure yet. My brother is arriving from Ha Noi on Friday night and I might have to stay with him.
Bring him along! There's still one seat free in the car.
That's kind, but he gets carsick on mountain roads. How long is the drive?
About six hours if we leave early. We're meeting at my house at five in the morning.
Five? That's painful. And where are we staying?
I booked a small guesthouse near the lake. It's not expensive — two hundred thousand each per night.
That's reasonable. What about food?
Breakfast is included, but we pay for our own lunch and dinner. Oh, and bring a warm jacket. It drops to twelve degrees at night up there.
Twelve? I'll definitely pack a jacket then. Let me call my brother tonight and I'll tell you tomorrow.

items.prompt: Tuan has already decided to go on the trip.
items.explain: SAI. Anh ấy nói "I'm not sure yet" và sẽ trả lời vào ngày mai.

items.prompt: There is space in the car for one more person.
items.explain: ĐÚNG. Mai nói "There's still one seat free in the car."

items.prompt: They are going to leave at five in the morning.
items.explain: ĐÚNG. "We're meeting at my house at five in the morning."

items.prompt: All meals are included in the price of the guesthouse.
items.explain: SAI. Chỉ có bữa sáng (breakfast is included); trưa và tối phải tự trả.

items.prompt: Mai warns Tuan that the nights are cold in Da Lat.
items.explain: ĐÚNG. "Bring a warm jacket. It drops to twelve degrees at night."

parts.title: Part 3 — Short talks: Best answer
parts.vi: Nghe thông báo ngắn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất
parts.instructions: You will hear five short talks. For each one, choose the best answer, A, B or C.

items.prompt: Why is the library closing early?

script.text: Attention please. The library will close at four o'clock today instead of nine. Engineers need to repair the air conditioning on the second floor, and the noise would disturb readers. We will reopen at the usual time tomorrow morning. Please take any books you need to the front desk before ten to four.

options.text: Because the readers are making noise
Because repair work is being done
Because the books are being counted

items.explain: Loa nói "Engineers need to repair the air conditioning on the second floor" → thư viện đóng cửa sớm vì có thợ đến sửa chữa (bị động tiếp diễn: is being done). “Because the readers are making noise” sai: tiếng ồn là do thợ sửa gây ra và sẽ làm phiền độc giả ("the noise would disturb readers"), chứ không phải độc giả gây ồn — bẫy dành cho người chỉ chộp được hai từ "noise" và "readers". “Because the books are being counted” sai: câu "take any books you need to the front desk before ten to four" chỉ là dặn ra quầy mượn sách xong trước 3 giờ 50; bài không hề nói đến chuyện kiểm kê hay đếm sách.

items.prompt: What does the speaker advise visitors to do?

script.text: Welcome to the museum. Photography is allowed in every room except the gallery on the top floor, where the light damages the old paintings. Bags larger than a small backpack must be left in the lockers by the entrance. The lockers are free, but you will need a ten thousand dong coin, which you get back afterwards.

options.text: Leave large bags in the lockers
Pay ten thousand dong to enter
Take photographs on the top floor

items.explain: Bài nói "Bags larger than a small backpack must be left in the lockers by the entrance" → lời khuyên là để túi lớn vào tủ khoá. “Pay ten thousand dong to enter” sai: đồng xu mười nghìn chỉ để dùng tủ và được lấy lại ("The lockers are free, but you will need a ten thousand dong coin, which you get back afterwards"), không phải tiền vào cửa. “Take photographs on the top floor” sai ngược hoàn toàn: tầng trên cùng (phòng tranh) lại đúng là nơi DUY NHẤT cấm chụp ảnh vì ánh sáng làm hỏng tranh cũ ("allowed in every room except the gallery on the top floor") — bẫy cho ai chỉ nghe thấy "photography is allowed" và "top floor".

items.prompt: What is the main change to the course?

script.text: A quick announcement about Thursday's English class. From next week the lesson moves from room B2 to room C14, because our group has grown and B2 is simply too small. The day and the time stay exactly the same. Please tell anyone who is absent today.

options.text: The day the class is held
The room the class is in

items.explain: "From next week the lesson moves from room B2 to room C14" → thay đổi duy nhất là phòng học. “The time the class starts” và “The day the class is held” sai vì bài khẳng định rõ "The day and the time stay exactly the same" — thứ và giờ giữ nguyên; người nghe lướt chỉ bắt được "Thursday" và "from next week" nên dễ tưởng lớp đổi thứ hoặc đổi giờ. Lớp đông lên ("our group has grown") chỉ là lý do phải đổi phòng, không phải bản thân thay đổi được thông báo.

items.prompt: What problem does the caller have?

script.text: Hi, this is Nam. I ordered a blue jacket from your website last Tuesday and it arrived this morning. The size is right and the quality is fine, but you have sent me a green one. I don't want a refund — I would just like to exchange it for the colour I ordered. Could you call me back on this number?

options.text: The jacket is the wrong size
The jacket is the wrong colour
The jacket is of poor quality

items.explain: "I ordered a blue jacket ... but you have sent me a green one" → Nam đặt áo xanh dương nhưng nhận áo xanh lá, nên vấn đề là sai màu, vì thế anh muốn đổi ("exchange it for the colour I ordered"). “The jacket is the wrong size” sai: chính người gọi khẳng định "The size is right" — bẫy cho ai chỉ nghe thấy từ "size". “The jacket is of poor quality” sai: người gọi cũng nói "the quality is fine", chất lượng không có vấn đề; anh ấy không đòi hoàn tiền ("I don't want a refund") mà chỉ muốn đổi đúng màu.

items.prompt: What does the speaker say about the tickets?

script.text: Tickets for Saturday's concert are still available, but only online. The box office at the theatre is closed for refurbishment until the end of the month, so please do not travel here to buy them in person. Students get a thirty percent discount if they upload a photo of their student card.

options.text: They can only be bought online
They cost less at the box office

items.explain: "Tickets for Saturday's concert are still available, but only online" → chỉ mua được trên mạng, vì phòng vé đóng cửa để sửa chữa. “They have completely sold out” sai: vé vẫn còn ("still available"), chưa bán hết — bẫy cho người nghe lướt chỉ bắt được cụm "the box office ... is closed". “They cost less at the box office” sai: phòng vé đóng đến cuối tháng nên không mua được ở đó, và mức giảm ba mươi phần trăm là dành cho sinh viên khi tải ảnh thẻ lên mạng, không liên quan đến giá tại phòng vé.

parts.title: Part 4 — Gap fill
parts.vi: Nghe và điền từ còn thiếu
parts.instructions: Listen to the message and complete the notes. Write ONE word or a number in each gap.

script.text: Good afternoon, this is a message for Ms Linh Pham from Riverside Sports Centre. You asked about our swimming courses for beginners.
The beginners' course runs on Tuesday and Thursday evenings, starting at seven o'clock. Each lesson lasts ninety minutes.
The full course is ten weeks and the total price is one million eight hundred thousand dong. That includes the use of the changing rooms but not the parking.
Please bring a swimming cap — it is compulsory in our pool — and arrive fifteen minutes early for your first lesson.
If you would like to book, call us back on zero nine zero, four four two, seven one eight three. Thank you.

items.prompt: Lessons are on Tuesday and ________ evenings.
items.explain: "Tuesday and Thursday evenings".

items.prompt: Each lesson lasts ________ minutes.
items.explain: "Each lesson lasts ninety minutes."

items.prompt: The course lasts ________ weeks in total.
items.explain: "The full course is ten weeks".

items.prompt: The price does not include ________.
items.explain: "That includes the use of the changing rooms but not the parking."

items.prompt: Students must bring a swimming ________.
items.explain: "Please bring a swimming cap — it is compulsory".
